📄 Document Reader – PDF Viewer & PDF Tools
This application comes with intuitive controls. On Android devices, you can access, view, convert and manage PDFs alongside various office files. Whether you need a PDF reader, format converter or a lightweight document viewer for study, daily work and business use cases, this app packs a full set of practical PDF features to streamline your daily tasks.

🔍 Document Viewing & Reading (Multi-format Supported)
The app starts up quickly and offers a smooth viewing experience. You can open and go through PDFs and many other types of documents without hassle.
It works with Word, Excel, PPT and PDF files, and is compatible with most commonly used document formats.
As an all-in-one document utility, it suits regular file browsing and content review perfectly.

🔄 File Conversion – PDF Conversion & Creation
This handy PDF generator and converter lets you switch formats for documents and images in quick steps.
You can save photos, PNG and JPG images as PDF files. The image conversion feature makes it simple to produce new PDF documents.
Built-in camera scanning is also available, letting you turn snapshots of physical paper documents directly into PDF files.

✂️ PDF File Management
Make use of the built-in tools to keep your PDF files well organized.
You can combine multiple PDF files into one, or split a single PDF into separate files.
Sort and arrange your documents using the recent file list and bookmark folders.
It runs standard document edits and everyday PDF operations stably.

📁 Streamlined File Management for Higher Efficiency
The app automatically scans all local PDF files stored on your device and presents them in a unified list. You can manage PDFs and other documents entirely within this app.
It fits well for learning, office work and mobile work scenarios, and helps you boost productivity in study and daily routines.

✅ Why Choose This App
It has a tidy interface and user-friendly operations, catering to students, office workers and all users who rely on PDF tools.
Download now to try this multi-purpose utility that combines PDF reading, PDF creation and general document viewing functions.
